title: How AI coding assistants actually work
angle: Explain the mechanics behind AI coding assistants: how they tokenize your code, understand context, and generate suggestions. Cover the difference between completion-based and chat-based assistants.

title: Building agentic workflows with LLMs
angle: Explore patterns for building autonomous agents that can plan, execute tools, and iterate. Cover loop architectures, tool calling, and common pitfalls like infinite loops and context overflow.

title: AI-powered code review: beyond linting
angle: Discuss how LLMs can review code for logic errors, security issues, and architectural concerns beyond what static analysis catches. Compare inline suggestions vs PR-level review.

title: Using LLMs for automated test generation
angle: Walk through strategies for using LLMs to generate unit tests, integration tests, and edge cases from code context. Cover prompt patterns, validation, and when human oversight is essential.

title: Multi-agent systems for software development
angle: Examine architectures where multiple AI agents collaborate on software tasks: a planner agent breaks down work, a coder implements, a reviewer critiques. Discuss coordination patterns and failure modes.

title: Prompt engineering for code generation
angle: Practical techniques for crafting prompts that produce better code: providing context, specifying constraints, using examples, requesting explanations, and iterating on output.

title: Integrating AI into your CI/CD pipeline
angle: Show how to add AI-powered steps to CI/CD: auto-generating release notes, summarizing PR changes, flagging risky diffs, and suggesting rollback strategies. Cover cost and latency trade-offs.

title: LLMs for automated documentation generation
angle: Survey approaches for generating docs from code: JSDoc/TSDoc comments, README generation, API reference docs, and changelogs. Discuss quality control and keeping docs in sync with code.

title: From design to code: AI-powered UI generation
angle: Analyze the current state of AI tools that convert designs (Figma, screenshots, sketches) into frontend code. Cover what works today, limitations, and practical workflows for web engineers.

title: Evaluating LLM outputs in engineering workflows
angle: Discuss strategies for evaluating AI-generated code and content: automated tests, manual review checklists, hallucination detection, and building evaluation datasets for your specific domain.

title: Using LLMs to improve API design
angle: Exploring how large language models can be used to generate, validate, and optimize API designs, including approaches for iterative refinement and automated testing. The post will cover practical examples and limitations of LLM-based API design tools.
rationale: As LLMs become more prevalent, their potential to augment traditional API design methodologies is increasingly relevant. This post fills a gap by discussing the intersection of LLMs and API design, providing readers with actionable insights and use cases.

title: Debugging LLM integrations in software systems
angle: Discussing the challenges and strategies for debugging LLM integrations, including techniques for identifying and addressing errors, biases, and performance issues. The post will cover real-world examples and best practices for LLM integration debugging.
rationale: As LLMs are integrated into more software systems, debugging these integrations becomes a critical challenge. This post addresses the need for practical guidance on debugging LLM integrations, providing readers with valuable insights and techniques.

title: Practical LLM-driven code refactoring strategies
angle: Exploring how LLMs can assist in code refactoring by identifying areas for improvement and suggesting targeted refactorings. Discussing the trade-offs between automated and human-in-the-loop approaches.
rationale: As LLMs become more prevalent in software development, their potential to aid in code refactoring is vast. This post fills a gap by providing actionable advice on integrating LLMs into refactoring workflows.

title: Optimizing LLM performance for resource-constrained environments
angle: Exploring techniques to reduce the computational requirements of LLMs, such as model pruning, knowledge distillation, and efficient inference algorithms. Focus on practical applications and trade-offs.
rationale: As LLMs become more ubiquitous, optimizing their performance is crucial for widespread adoption, especially in resource-constrained environments. This post fills a gap by providing actionable advice on optimizing LLM performance.

title: LLM-based code analysis for security vulnerabilities
angle: Using LLMs to identify potential security vulnerabilities in code, including pattern recognition and anomaly detection. Focus on integration with existing security tools and workflows.
rationale: As LLMs become more prevalent in software development, their potential for code analysis is vast. This post fills a gap by exploring the practical applications of LLM-based code analysis for security.

title: Designing micro-frontends for complex web applications
angle: Practical strategies for designing and implementing micro-frontend architectures, including componentization, integration, and deployment. Focus on real-world examples and lessons learned.
rationale: Micro-frontend architecture is becoming increasingly popular, but there is a lack of concrete guidance on designing and implementing these systems. This post provides timely and practical advice.

title: Optimizing LLM training data for improved code generation
angle: Techniques for curating, preprocessing, and optimizing LLM training data to improve code generation quality, including data augmentation, filtering, and weighting. Focus on empirical results and best practices.
rationale: High-quality training data is essential for effective LLM-based code generation. This post addresses a critical gap by providing actionable advice on optimizing LLM training data.

title: database performance optimization techniques
angle: In-depth analysis of database performance optimization techniques: indexing strategies, query optimization, and data modeling best practices. Focus on relational databases and their limitations.
rationale: Database performance is a critical aspect of software engineering, but many developers lack a deep understanding of optimization techniques. This post provides a comprehensive guide to database performance optimization.

title: security in ci/cd pipelines
angle: Practical approaches to securing ci/cd pipelines: secret management, access control, and vulnerability scanning. Focus on integrating security into existing workflows.
rationale: CI/CD pipelines are increasingly complex, and security is often an afterthought. This post highlights the importance of security in ci/cd pipelines and provides actionable advice for securing them.

title: securing your api endpoints with best practices
angle: A comprehensive overview of api security best practices, including authentication, authorization, and input validation. Focus on practical implementation of owasp guidelines.
rationale: API security is a critical aspect of software development, and many developers struggle to implement secure api endpoints. This post fills the gap by providing actionable advice and real-world examples.

title: optimizing your ci/cd pipeline for faster deployment
angle: Practical strategies for optimizing your ci/cd pipeline, including parallelization, caching, and automated testing. Focus on reducing deployment time and improving overall efficiency.
rationale: As software development cycles become shorter, optimizing ci/cd pipelines is crucial for faster deployment and improved productivity. This post provides actionable tips and real-world examples.
